expectations.text: Names the five parts: lead magnet, landing page, thank you page, sales page, follow-up funnel
Recommends a curiosity 'hook' and a pain-focused lead magnet (e.g., 'The # Biggest Mistakes...' formula / Myron Golden tip)
expectations.evidence: Mistake hook and curiosity hooks given

expectations.text: Says landing pages need a headline, image of the lead magnet, and opt-in form, kept simple
expectations.evidence: Squeeze page: headline, image, email form, no distractions

expectations.text: Says the thank you page should deliver the lead magnet and offer one next step (product, webinar, or podcast/blog), with no bait-and-switch
expectations.evidence: Delivery plus next offer but no 'one step'/no bait-and-switch rule

expectations.text: Mentions 'the money is in the list' and/or building a relationship via follow-up and daily publishing
